issue_request: FHIR-17223 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core HTTP technical correction asking to change the GET compartment search URL from `[base]/[Compartment]/[id]/{*?...}` to `[base]/[Compartment]/[id]/*{?...}` and to note that the literal `*` means all resource types in the compartment.
initial_application: The Jira comments record SVN revision 14180. Imported git commit e69671f97d1f8c1f6564601b041bd6ebe1ff228f (`GF#17223 - typo`) changed `source/http.html` from `[id]/{*` to `[id]/*{` and added prose explaining that `*` appears literally to mean all types.
additional_context: The referenced Zulip thread confirms the request: Grahame Grieve identified the original URL as a typo, gave the corrected `/*{?...}` syntax, and explained that `*` means resources of all types. Current `source/search.html` also describes literal `*` for GET-based compartment search and shows the same pattern. A later FHIR-51608 source commit clarified adjacent compartment-search behavior and cross-links without reversing this correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current `source/http.html` uses `GET [base]/[Compartment]/[id]/*{?[parameters]{&_format=[mime-type]}}`, explains the literal `*`, and no obsolete `[id]/{*` pattern was found in the checked compartment-search source locations.
